versions.content: To close related TcpIp sockets on closing a socket connection within SoAd_MainFunction(), SoAd shall perform the following actions: (1) In case of a TCP socket connection: (a) Close the related socket by calling TcpIp_CloseSocket() with parameter abort set to the same value as provided by SoAd_CloseSoCon() or set to FALSE in case closing was not initiated by SoAd_CloseSoCon() . (b) If all socket connection s of a TCP socket connection group have been closed by SoAd_CloseSoCon() : Close the related Listen - Socket by calling TcpIp_CloseSocket() with parameter abort set to the same value as provided by SoAd_CloseSoCon() or set to FALSE in case closing was not initiated by SoAd_CloseSoCon() . (2) In case of a UDP socket connection: (a) If the socket connection is NOT part of a socket co nnection group (i.e. there is only one socket connection in the socket connection group configuration container): Close the related socket by calling TcpIp_CloseSocket() with parameter abort set to the same value as provided by SoAd_CloseSoCon() or set to F ALSE in case closing was not initiated by SoAd_CloseSoCon(). (b) If all socket connection s of a UDP socket connection group have been closed by SoAd_CloseSoCon() : Close the related UDP socket by calling TcpIp_CloseSocket() with parameter abort set to the same value as provided by SoAd_CloseSoCon() or set to FALSE in case closing was not initiated by SoAd_CloseSoCon() .
